name: LienWaiverComplianceTracker
tagline: Collect every conditional and unconditional lien waiver – and hold payments until they are in.
description: A complete lien waiver compliance app for general contractors: conditional and unconditional progress and final waivers per pay application, party and tier (subcontractors, suppliers, sub-tier suppliers), amount, through-date and notarisation checks, payment holds with release and paid tracking, pay period matrix, chase emails and a payment hold report – in one Power Apps code component for canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Four waiver types per pay application and party
Approval checks: amount vs payment, through date, notarisation, exceptions, unconditional only after payment
Payment holds: conditional, prior unconditional and sub-tier rules
Release payment (optional authorised override), mark paid, manual hold
Unconditional waiver requested automatically after payment
Open next pay application – conditional waivers requested from every party
Chase emails per party, hold report and CSV export
